t: Real Research Today: Open-Source Hardware Economies
title: Real Research Today: Open-Source Hardware Economies
definition: Today's documented research behind Open-Source Hardware Economies.
description:
The road to Open-Source Hardware Economies is already being paved. Kenya's GiveDirectly UBI trials and Stockton's SEED program tested basic income at city scale. Open-source hardware (Arduino, RISC-V) shows zero-marginal-cost production at scale.

Elinor Ostrom's Nobel-winning work on governing the commons underpins commons economics. Together these programs form the design commons foundation that Open-Source Hardware Economies will build on — the economy logistics results, the certification methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as economy logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

definition: Estimates Open-Source Hardware Economies readiness from component maturity.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where design commons monitoring, economy logistics redundancy, or certification maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Open-Source Hardware Economies Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Open-Source Hardware Economies: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Open-Source Hardware Economies — economies around open hardware.

Phase 1 — Prove (design commons): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (economy logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (certification): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (manufacturing nets): economy hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and makers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
